client_host_findings: PWA remains one separate installable Zero/Go/Hub app with public shell caching and read-only same-origin no-store projections. It currently has no hosted conversation transport, authenticated session bootstrap, durable encrypted private working set or governed offline conversation replay.

Native mobile recognizes Zero/Go/Hub but its session DTO has no session_id/context_revision; the adapter sends a completed Future<Map> request with an items response shape and omits host-required session_id/interaction_id/client_message_id. It only requires a nonempty response revision, accepting a revision change between request and response.

Neither client implements incremental event parsing, event-log resume or conversation cancel. Workforce SSE is serialized only after awaited dispatch completes; Last-Event-ID filters that completed event array rather than replaying a durable event log.

Workforce current main is hosted Zero-only; Go/Hub are rejected pending a server-owned authority-aware dispatcher. Client continuity owner #1182/#1188 remains separate from #302 identity and #1049 SDK owners.

Company ID remains the canonical scope boundary from the authenticated session; client-supplied company or surface values confer no authority. Logout/company/context revision rotation must clear private client cache and queued work; auth, stale, unconfigured, unavailable and canceled states need distinct UI handling.
